Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-barranco-segovia-cueva-de-la-plat.story: A 246 km round trip from Letur - roughly 4 h 14 in the saddle. It goes by way of L. Tello I. Cama del Pastor, Cueva de la Plata and back through L. Tello I. Cama del Pastor. The highest point is about 1,200 m. The line favours views over speed.
